command.description: The command to execute or attach to.

follow_forks.description: Trace child processes as they are created (-f).

daemonize.description: Run tracer process as a grandchild (-D).

attach_pids.description: List of PIDs to attach to instead of running a command. If empty, command is run.

output_file.description: Write trace output to this file. Empty means stderr.

output_append.description: Open output file in append mode (-A).

output_separately.description: Write each process trace to filename.pid (-ff implies -f).

trace_set.description: List of syscall names or categories to trace (e.g., 'network', 'read', 'write').

syscall_limit.description: Detach after this number of syscalls (0 for unlimited).

kill_on_exit.description: Send SIGKILL to tracees if strace exits (--kill-on-exit).

run_as_user.description: Run command with the user/group ID of this username (-u).

environment_vars.description: List of environment variable assignments or removals (-E).
